args.body: Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Based on the text I could access, your site clearly identifies itself as your personal website and makes your contact email easy to find. I'd suggest adding a short introduction about yourself and a few examples of your interests or work so visitors have more to explore. I could only review the available text, so I can't comment on the visual design.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Based on the text I could access, mentioning hiking gives your blog a personal touch. I'd love to see that developed into posts about favorite trails, memorable hikes, or practical tips for readers. A short introduction and links to recent posts would also help visitors discover more. I could only review the available text, so I can't comment on the visual design.

final_text:
Visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack, and sent each of them feedback:

- **Dora:** Highlighted her easy-to-find contact email and suggested adding an introduction and examples of her interests or work.
- **Eve:** Highlighted the personal touch of mentioning hiking and suggested trail stories, practical tips, and links to recent posts.

The feedback was based on the available website text, not the visual design.
